svg.title: Edge MLP on a radius graph, fused tile kernel
svg.desc: Points within distance r of a query point send it messages. Each message is produced by a small MLP run on the edge displacement and source features; messages are summed per destination. The compiler fuses the whole chain into one tile kernel so no per-edge message tensor is materialized.
svg.text: A small neural network on every edge, fused into one tile kernel
messages live only inside the tile — no (E, ·) message tensor is materialized
backward replays the chain in the same tile — training materializes nothing per edge either
